items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Do you remember the name of Lada, Anton Lada? He was a New Orleans boy who worked with them.

ctx.x: I don't, I had nothing to do with Louisiana Five.
Don't recall. Do you remember the name of Lada, Anton Lada? He was a New Orleans boy who worked with them.
